== English errata comparison sources ==
Changes any alien warrior to your alien warrior, specifies a character target, changes Character is to Target is, and checks defense value rather than ability. Deploy cost 1, Tatooine exception, free targeting, single destiny +2, forfeit -2 and duration remain. Unrestricted Light Character Weapon, destiny 5, same lore and printing identity. Separate Dark counterpart.

Decipher, [https://swccg.com/wiki/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=92 Glossary 2.0], November 1998, PDF page 92, Mos Eisley Blaster. Players Committee, [https://swccg.com/wiki/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=122 PC Appendix A], Appendix A, PDF page 122.
